review_method: 25 full-body checkpoints, 5 face windows, 25 foot windows, 5 clothing windows, plus all 156 selected-frame thumbnails viewed as contact sheets
sampled_visual_result: No blocking identity, wardrobe, hand-bag, foot or background defect observed at inspection scale. Candidate may enter paired-cut review.

observations.face: Opening smiling leftward face gradually becomes a more forward/forward-right neutral expression around 2-3 seconds. Selected interval has relatively consistent appearance; no abrupt identity jump observed.
observations.clothes: Checked shirt, collar, sleeve rolls, charcoal trouser waistband and hems remain readable. Pattern deforms with folds rather than visibly changing to a different print.
observations.hands_bag: Black shoulder bag stays at outer hip; no visible crossing through torso or major hand deformity in samples. Bag-side arm has restrained swing.
observations.feet: Continuous alternating short steps, intact low-heeled shoes, heel lift and contact. Some narrow/crossing steps; normal-speed naturalness not established by still inspection.
observations.background: Columns, window bays, steps and paving pass in a consistent direction. Hair/face illumination becomes somewhat warmer/brighter as the walk advances; no abrupt object pop or wall warp observed in selected thumbnails.

limits: Contact sheets do not establish complete normal-speed playback or subjective walking-speed comfort.
Source inspection does not approve the J12 dissolve, complete film, audience usefulness or production efficiency.
Cut point may be adjusted only after reviewing S01-S02 gait, subject scale, major background lines and exposure together.
